sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: dealer); size 385 x 465 x 98 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Dealer listings (Reverb, Thomann, zZounds, B&H, Perfect Circuit) read through a search summary 2026-11-12: six mono channels with XLR mic inputs and 1/4 in line inputs, four stereo channels, balanced XLR stereo main outputs, a 1/4 in mono main output, RCA record and alt outputs, 1/4 in insert jacks, 1/4 in and 3.5 mm headphone outputs, one USB-B port (2 in, 2 out). The listings disagree on the mic and insert counts and no mains connection is stated, so beta-modelled with a subset (2 mic, 2 line, main L / R, phones, USB). The sloped profile is an estimate. 385 x 465 x 98 mm (dealer, size ok). Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened.
